description:
Retype issue ids in error types, output DTOs and the visualization renderer.

## Background

`errors.rs` holds 45 production issue-id references and 9 raw-id signatures; its `short_id` helper (`errors.rs:995`) truncates by length and is called at `errors.rs:949,954` and `output.rs:32,106,134,1276,1283`, and `errors.rs:504,557` truncate directly. `output.rs` declares id-carrying DTO fields (`output.rs:1421,1554,1563,1625,1689,1749,1836,1857,2363,2390,2627,2781,2831`). `visualization.rs:242` truncates with a literal length.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No error variant, output DTO field or function parameter in `errors.rs`, `output.rs` or `visualization.rs` holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`; each uses `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `errors::short_id` helper is gone, and short ids in these files come only from `short_id()`.
- [hard] REQ-03: JSON error payloads and command output are byte-identical before and after.
- [hard] REQ-04: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Errors and output carry typed issue ids
